LanguageData.RP_AmendsText:
{0}, the counsellor, proposes a restorative meeting for {1}, inside for {2}. The family of the one they hurt would come to the visitation room (searched at the gate like any visitor), {1} would be brought to them as for a visit, and a counsellor would sit with them. It takes about {3} hours of the counsellor's day and costs {4}.

Why now - {5}.

The odds it goes well - about {6} ({7}). That is with {0} at the table; whichever counsellor sits in counts {16} for each level of their own Social skill. Should no counsellor make it to the table, about {8}.{15}

If it goes well, the family withdraws its letter to the parole board (a letter worth {9} at a hearing), or even speaks for them ({10}). {1}'s tension falls by {11} and their chance of reoffending drops a band.
If it goes badly, the family leaves hostile and writes against them at every hearing, the press may hear of it ({13} of the time, -{14} reputation), and their tension rises by {12}.

It can be tried once in a stay. Left unanswered, the letter is a no.
